desc:
🥚 Welcome to Wack A Pet!

How to Play:
🔨 Bop the bosses until they drop eggs
🏃 Grab an egg and RUN - everyone else wants it too!
🥚 Keep it safe for a few seconds and it's yours
🐣 Grow eggs on your farm and hatch them into pets
💰 Earn money from every pet on your farm
💪 Train on your Whacker Machine to get stronger
⬆️ Upgrade your Whacker Machine and expand your farm
✨ Collect rarer pets in bigger sizes - up to Colossal and Divine!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
